description: Connect your Rolino workspace to find projects, review saved social posts and calendar entries, read Blog drafts, and explore stored SEO evidence. Create and edit social drafts from ChatGPT. This version supports saved record reads and social draft changes only. Publishing, schedule changes, uploads, deletion, and provider management are not available. Access depends on your workspace and granted permissions.

defaultPrompt: Show my Rolino projects and their current content work.
Prepare a draft social post for my next campaign. Ask me to choose the project if needed.
Find content opportunities from my stored SEO evidence.
